notes: Jesus stands among stones in a rocky wilderness while a swirl of golden dust and dark smoke rises beside him. That swirl is the only sign of the tempter: there is no creature and no figure.

A raised colonnaded house in a hilly city has an open door under a warm ember-coloured cloud glow, with a clay jar on the street below. No bread or lamplight shows, but it fits sitting at a door in the high places of the city.
A heavenly hall of pillars and clouds is filled with robed sons of God. A dark smoke trail winds in from the left among them, standing for Satan, and there is no figure of God in the light.
Jesus faces a deep-red, many-headed horned serpent-dragon in a desert scattered with stones. The canon form is clear and nothing contradicts the temptation scene.

The high priest Joshua stands with a red seven-headed serpent on his right (the viewer's left), and the haloed angel sits on a red horse behind. Joshua resting his hand on the coils is odd, but the scene fits the verse.

The haloed angel sits on a red horse at left, Joshua is in the centre and a red many-headed serpent mass is at right. The serpent is on Joshua's left rather than his right, a minor slip; the breastplate marks read as stones, not script.
Jesus looks down at stones while a human-shaped dark silhouette looms in drifting dust at the right. That silhouette stands for the tempter, which goes against the canon's 'no human body'.
Joshua in soiled priestly robes stands in a courtyard, with the glowing angel on a red horse among trees. Nothing stands for Satan, so the adversary at his right hand is missing.

A dark dragon made of smoke and fire, with ember red in it, plunges from a heavenly temple with a rainbow, with meteors (his angels) falling as onlookers watch. It is a creature form but single-headed and not clearly red.

A red serpentine dragon with two heads falls in smoke and flame below a heavenly court with a rainbow. Winged human figures float in the radiant clouds at the top; they are heavenly angels, not the dragon's angels the verse names.
In a pillared heavenly court with clouds and flames, robed sons of God gather, and a dark smoke cloud drifts among them on the left. The smoke is the only sign of Satan, with no figure in the light.
Jesus stands over scattered stones while a tall human-shaped shadow forms in a dust haze at the right. That shadow stands for the tempter, so the entry is a human-like figure.
A red seven-headed dragon with crowns and horns coils in a cloud above the crowned woman on the moon, with kneeling angels and a temple holding an empty throne. This fits the 'sign in heaven' well.
Jesus faces a huge coiled many-headed serpent with a clawed arm beside a pile of stones. The scales are dark grey-black rather than red, but it is clearly the serpentine many-headed form.

A red many-headed serpent-dragon rises on Joshua's right, and the glowing angel sits on a red horse at right in a night olive grove. The angel's glow is allowed because the verse puts him in the scene.
A red seven-headed dragon with crowns and horns flies over the sea toward a golden city, watched by figures on a cliff. It matches the verse with no faults.
Jesus faces a deep-red, many-headed coiled serpent reaching out a claw, with stones at his feet in a pale wilderness. It is clearly the canon form.
A red seven-headed winged dragon with crowns flies through red-tinged clouds above a city, with robed men watching. It fits the verse.

A red seven-headed crowned dragon arches above a crystal floor, and the crowned woman stands on a crescent moon surrounded by a golden glowing aura. She is not named in v.3, so she counts as a figure in radiance.

A dragon formed of dark smoke and embers falls from a heavenly temple with a rainbow and an empty throne, with meteors falling and onlookers below. It is a creature shape, but single-headed and not red.
Joshua in torn robes stands in a paved court with the glowing angel on a red horse among trees. Only Joshua's own cast shadow lies to his left; nothing stands for Satan at his right hand.

The glowing angel on a horse is at left and Joshua in stained robes at right. A long dark shadow stretches from Joshua's feet toward his right, which may be meant as Satan or may just be his cast shadow, so the adversary is not evident.

A columned house at the top of a walled hill city has an open, warmly lit door with a stone seat beside it, and jars stand at the gate below. No bread shows, but it neatly fits a seat at the door in the high places.
Robed sons of God crowd a radiant hall with golden clouds and flames, and a grey-black smoke bank rolls in at right as Satan. There is no figure in the light.

A stone house on a raised terrace has an open door with a clay jar and a stone seat beside it, under a warm glowing cloud, while men walk past. There is no bread or interior lamplight, but it fits the verse.

A dark-red, many-headed dragon falls amid smoke and fire from a heavenly court with a rainbow and an empty throne. Winged angels hover in the radiant light at the top; they are not the dragon's angels named in the verse.

A winged dragon formed of brown smoke and embers plunges from a heavenly floor with an empty throne, trailing meteors, as people on the ground look up. It is a creature form but single-headed and not red.
A red seven-headed dragon with gold crowns and horns towers over the crowned woman, white-robed crowds and a temple with a rainbow and an empty throne. It fits the verse.

A columned house sits at the top of a terraced city, with light beams spilling from its open door and a seat beside it, and jars in the town below. No bread shows, but it fits sitting at her door in the high places.
A red-black many-headed serpent coils among two rows of robed sons of God in a cloudy, pillared heavenly hall. It fits 'Satan also came among them'.
A long red many-headed serpent moves through rows of robed figures in a radiant heavenly hall. There is no figure in the swirling light.
A red seven-headed crowned dragon coils through storm clouds, with a heavenly temple to one side, a city across the water and people watching from the shore. It matches the verse.
A red many-headed dragon falls in smoke and fire off the edge of a heavenly court with an empty throne and a rainbow. Winged angels float in the clouds at the top left, which the verse does not name.
A red many-headed serpent coils among robed sons of God in a luminous pillared hall. There is no figure in the light.

A walled city has a columned house on its hilltop, with a dim, partly open door and a jar, and jars and baskets lie at the gate below. There is no lamplight, glow or distinct seat to single out the woman's doorway.
A golden, ember-like glowing cloud spills from the open doorway of a columned house with a stone seat as passers-by walk on. The picture is boxed by a drawn ink border line inside a paper margin.
